CalculationType.title: CalculationType
CalculationType.description:
The calculation a metric runs over its events or profiles.

Separate from the interval aggregation, which rolls those calculated values
up across time buckets.

CohortBreakdown.title: CohortBreakdown
CohortBreakdown.description: Groups results by membership in each of the given saved cohorts.

CohortFilter.title: CohortFilter
CohortFilter.description: Keeps users who are, or are not, members of a saved cohort.

group_key.title: Group Key
group_key.description: The key property name of a data group, as shown in Lexicon -- for example `$company_id`. `User` is the user profile and the default.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Profile property or cohort filters narrowing the members counted.

value.title: Value
value.description: Number of periods back to compare against, up to 2 years: 730 days, 104 weeks, 24 months, 8 quarters.

ComparisonOffset.title: ComparisonOffset
ComparisonOffset.description: How far back the comparison period sits from the queried window.

value.title: Value
value.description: Whole number of `unit`s, at most 31708800 seconds, 528480 minutes, 8808 hours, 367 days, 52 weeks, 12 months, 12 sessions.

unit.description: `session` counts sessions instead of time: with value N, the funnel must complete within the session of the first step or the N - 1 sessions after it.

ConversionWindow.title: ConversionWindow
ConversionWindow.description: How long after the first step an entity has to complete the funnel.

CustomEvent.title: CustomEvent
CustomEvent.description: A saved custom event, referenced by its id.

DatetimeUnit.title: DatetimeUnit
DatetimeUnit.description:
Bucket for a datetime property. The first six are calendar units; the
last two are cyclic.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the event as tracked, not its Lexicon display name.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: An event tracked into the project.

EventCountMeasurement.title: EventCountMeasurement
EventCountMeasurement.description: Counts matching events, sessions, or users.

EventCustomJoinKey.title: EventCustomJoinKey
EventCustomJoinKey.description:
A saved event custom property a lookup table is attached to.

The server resolves the custom property's formula and
``mapped_data_group_id`` to produce the join key selector.

path.title: Path
path.description: Key path into an object-valued property.

EventCustomProperty.title: EventCustomProperty
EventCustomProperty.description: A saved custom property computed on the event, by id.

percentile.title: Percentile
percentile.description: The percentile to compute, strictly between 0 and 100; 50 is the median. Required for, and only for, calculation `percentile`.

EventFrequencyPerUserMeasurement.title: EventFrequencyPerUserMeasurement
EventFrequencyPerUserMeasurement.description: A statistic over how many matching events each user performed.

EventJoinKey.title: EventJoinKey
EventJoinKey.description: An event property a lookup table is attached to.

group_key.title: Group Key
group_key.description: The key property name of a data group, as shown in Lexicon -- for example `$company_id`. `User` is the user profile and the default.

path.title: Path
path.description: Key path into an object-valued property.

EventProperty.title: EventProperty
EventProperty.description: A property recorded on the event.

percentile.title: Percentile
percentile.description: The percentile to compute, strictly between 0 and 100; 50 is the median. Required for, and only for, calculation `percentile`.

EventPropertyMeasurement.title: EventPropertyMeasurement
EventPropertyMeasurement.description:
A statistic over a property's values across all matching events.

Every calculation except `distinct_count` needs a number property.

percentile.title: Percentile
percentile.description: The percentile to compute, strictly between 0 and 100; 50 is the median. Required for, and only for, calculation `percentile`.

per_user.title: Per User
per_user.description: What is computed for each user (each `group_key` entity) before `calculation` runs across users.

EventPropertyPerUserMeasurement.title: EventPropertyPerUserMeasurement
EventPropertyPerUserMeasurement.description:
Aggregates a property for each user, then a statistic across users.

`per_user` other than `distinct_count` needs a number property.

formula.title: Formula
formula.description: Arithmetic over other metrics in this request, each named by its `display_name` in curly braces: `{Purchases} / {Signups} * 100`. Supports `+ - * / ^`, parentheses, and numbers. Formulas cannot reference other formulas.

calculation.title: Calculation
calculation.description: Determines how conversions are counted: total users, events, or sessions. With `total_sessions`, the metric's `conversion_window` defaults to one session and accepts no other value.

FunnelConversionRateMeasurement.title: FunnelConversionRateMeasurement
FunnelConversionRateMeasurement.description: The share of entities that complete the funnel, counted per `calculation`.

calculation.title: Calculation
calculation.description: Determines how conversions are counted: total users, events, or sessions. With `total_sessions`, the metric's `conversion_window` defaults to one session and accepts no other value.

FunnelCountMeasurement.title: FunnelCountMeasurement
FunnelCountMeasurement.description: Counts the entities, events, or sessions that complete the funnel.

group_key.title: Group Key
group_key.description: The key property name of a data group, as shown in Lexicon -- for example `$company_id`. `User` is the user profile and the default.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The funnel steps, first to last.

conversion_window.description: How long after the first step the funnel must complete: a span of time or up to 12 sessions. Defaults to 7 days. Measurements with the `total_sessions` calculation accept only one session.

order.description: ordered: steps in sequence, other events may occur between them. any: the steps after the first may happen in any order.

FunnelOrder.title: FunnelOrder
FunnelOrder.description:
`ordered`: steps in sequence, other events may occur between them.
`any`: the steps after the first may happen in any order.

FunnelPropertyMeasurement.title: FunnelPropertyMeasurement
FunnelPropertyMeasurement.description: The sum of a number property over the last-step event of each conversion.

FunnelStep.title: FunnelStep
FunnelStep.description: One funnel step: the event an entity performs at that position.

percentile.title: Percentile
percentile.description: The percentile to compute, strictly between 0 and 100; 50 is the median. Required for, and only for, calculation `percentile`.

FunnelTimeToConvertMeasurement.title: FunnelTimeToConvertMeasurement
FunnelTimeToConvertMeasurement.description: A statistic over how long converting entities took, in seconds.

InsightsQueryRequest.title: InsightsQueryRequest
InsightsQueryRequest.description: Root request body for the public Insights API.

LiftComparison.title: LiftComparison
LiftComparison.description:
Reports each result as a change against a baseline rather than an
absolute value.

LiftType.title: LiftType
LiftType.description:
What each result is expressed relative to: `overall` the total across
breakdown values, `time` the request's earlier window.

ListItem.title: ListItem
ListItem.description:
Reads one primitive key out of each object in a `list[object]` property,
so the list can be filtered or broken down like a `list[<type>]`.

`key_path` is the path from the object root to the leaf value, matching
the internal ``propertyObjectKey`` format: ``["sku"]`` for a top-level
key, ``["details", "sku"]`` for a nested one.

ListMatch.title: ListMatch
ListMatch.description:
How a filter treats a list-valued property: match when any element
passes, or only when all do.

LogicalOperators.title: LogicalOperators
LogicalOperators.description: Logical operators that define how lists of `Filter` objects are combined.

path.title: Path
path.description: Key path into an object-valued property.

LookupProperty.title: LookupProperty
LookupProperty.description:
A column of a lookup table, reached through the property it is joined on.

The table is not named: each join key maps to at most one lookup table, and
a column name alone is ambiguous across tables. Group profiles are not
lookup tables; their properties are `profile` properties with a `group_key`.

intervals.title: Intervals
intervals.description: Ascending breakpoints for uneven buckets; overrides `bucket_size`.

NumericBuckets.title: NumericBuckets
NumericBuckets.description: Fixed-width buckets over a number property, or explicit `intervals`.

Operator.title: Operator
Operator.description:
Comparison applied by a `PropertyFilter`.

Which operators are valid follows from the property's type; the filter
does not restate the type.

ProfileCustomJoinKey.title: ProfileCustomJoinKey
ProfileCustomJoinKey.description:
A saved user profile custom property a lookup table is attached to.

A `profile_custom` join key always means the `$user_id` profile.

path.title: Path
path.description: Key path into an object-valued property.

group_key.title: Group Key
group_key.description: The key property name of a data group, as shown in Lexicon -- for example `$company_id`. `User` is the user profile and the default.

ProfileCustomProperty.title: ProfileCustomProperty
ProfileCustomProperty.description:
A saved custom property computed on a user or group profile, by id.

`group_key` names which profile, as for `profile` properties.

ProfileJoinKey.title: ProfileJoinKey
ProfileJoinKey.description:
A user profile property a lookup table is attached to.

A `profile` join key always means the `$user_id` profile.

path.title: Path
path.description: Key path into an object-valued property.

group_key.title: Group Key
group_key.description: The key property name of a data group, as shown in Lexicon -- for example `$company_id`. `User` is the user profile and the default.

ProfileProperty.title: ProfileProperty
ProfileProperty.description:
A property on a user profile or a group profile (company, organization,
...), read as of query time.

`group_key` names which profile. Whether the value is a direct read or a
join depends on the metric's `group_key`: a company property under a
user-based metric is joined; under a company-based metric it is not.

datetime_unit.description: Bucket for datetime properties. Omit for ISO-formatted breakdowns.

PropertyBreakdown.title: PropertyBreakdown
PropertyBreakdown.description:
Groups results by a property's values.

The optional bucketing follows the property's type: `datetime_unit` for
datetime, `numeric_buckets` for number, `string_groups` for string.

values.title: Values
values.description: Operands. Omitted for `is set`, `is not set`, `is true`, `is false`; exactly two for `is between` / `is not between`; one for `contains`, `does not contain` and the other number operators; one or more for `equals` / `does not equal`, any of which may match.

list_match.description: For list-valued properties, and for lookup columns whose join key is list-valued. Defaults to `any`.

list_item_match.description: For `list[object]` properties whose `list_item` is list-valued: whether any or all elements of each object's list must pass. Defaults to `any`. `list_match` quantifies over the objects.

keep_only_matching.title: Keep Only Matching
keep_only_matching.description: For list-valued properties with `list_match: any`: drop the list elements that did not match instead of keeping the whole list.

PropertyFilter.title: PropertyFilter
PropertyFilter.description: Keeps events or profiles whose property passes the comparison.

PropertyType.title: PropertyType
PropertyType.description:
The type a property's value is interpreted as.

Required: the server does not look a property's type up, and without one
it emits an uncast selector whose behavior depends on the stored value.
`list[object]` is only usable together with `list_item`, which picks one
key out of each object.

align_to_whole_unit.title: Align To Whole Unit
align_to_whole_unit.description: false: `value` units before now. true: rounded to a whole `unit`. For example: start 2 weeks ago -> false: 14 days before today; true: the beginning of that calendar week. end 1 month ago -> false: 30 days before today; true: the last day of the previous calendar month.

RetentionCountMeasurement.title: RetentionCountMeasurement
RetentionCountMeasurement.description: Counts the entities retained in the bucket.

RetentionCriteria.title: RetentionCriteria
RetentionCriteria.description:
When a return event counts toward a bucket: `on` that bucket only,
`on_or_after` that bucket or any later one, `on_or_before` that bucket or
any earlier one, `streak` every bucket up to and including it.

group_key.title: Group Key
group_key.description: The key property name of a data group, as shown in Lexicon -- for example `$company_id`. `User` is the user profile and the default.

start_event.title: Start Event
start_event.description: The event that starts an entity's retention clock.

return_event.title: Return Event
return_event.description: The event that counts as returning.

unit.description: The size of each retention bucket after the start event.

bucket.title: Bucket
bucket.description: Which retention bucket to report, in `unit`s after the start event: 0 is the start bucket; with unit `day`, 7 is Day 7. Must be within the project's retention interval limit, 60 by default.

criteria.description: When a return event counts toward the bucket: on that bucket only, on it or any later one, on it or any earlier one, or on every bucket up to it (streak).

RetentionPropertyMeasurement.title: RetentionPropertyMeasurement
RetentionPropertyMeasurement.description:
A number property over the cohort's return events in the bucket: `sum` adds it
up, `average` is the mean of each cohort member's sum, counting members who did not
return as 0.

RetentionRateMeasurement.title: RetentionRateMeasurement
RetentionRateMeasurement.description: The share of entities that did the start event and returned in the bucket.

RollingAverage.title: RollingAverage
RollingAverage.description:
A rolling average over the course of a few intervals, determined by Time's unit.
The request must set `time.unit`.

params:
    size: number of intervals over which to derive the average

values.title: Values
values.description: One or more values for `equals`, any of which may match; one for `contains`.

StringGroup.title: StringGroup
StringGroup.description:
A named bucket of string values. `""` is a valid value: it groups the
records whose property is the empty string.

anyOf.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the project's timezone. Covers the whole day.
Timestamp, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, in the project's timezone. Covers the whole minute.

start.title: Start
start.description: Inclusive. Relative hour and minute starts are limited to 336 hours.

anyOf.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the project's timezone. Covers the whole day.
Timestamp, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, in the project's timezone. Covers the whole minute.

unit.description: The bucket size of the time series. When omitted, the query returns a single value for the whole range, and for a retention metric everyone who did the start event in the range forms one cohort. Rolling averages require a unit.

TimeComparison.title: TimeComparison
TimeComparison.description: An earlier window to run the same query over.
